technical.summary: ABBV shows strong bullish structure with Ichimoku cross-up and new highs, but overbought conditions across RSI/Stoch/Williams-R and declining volume ratio limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 84 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity with no clear directional signal; broad market fear (36/100) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (336.0) with imminent NFP event creates severe near-term volatility risk; normal yield curve and flat DXY provide limited offset; 84-day earnings window mitigates binary event risk but macro conditions are highly unfavourable.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical structure with Ichimoku cross-up, new 20-day highs, price above all major MAs, and supertrend bullish alignment provides directional confirmation in a fear-zone contrarian setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (336.0), widespread overbought conditions (RSI-9/14, Stoch, Williams-R), collapsing volume ratio (0.77), zero fundamental conviction, and imminent NFP volatility event create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry despite technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is constructive with Ichimoku cross-up and new highs, but entry is negated by extreme macro crisis (VIX 336), widespread overbought conditions, and imminent NFP volatility spike that will likely trigger stop-losses.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis regime combined with NFP event risk creates uncontrollable volatility; overbought technicals across all momentum indicators suggest mean reversion is more probable than continuation.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical strength insufficient to overcome macro/fundamental/risk headwinds
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 24 Health Care positions with existing ABBV exposure; sector concentration is extreme and drawdown buffer is zero — adding to this position violates concentration limits and increases portfolio fragility in crisis regime.
